name: Yokubou Kaiki Dai 405 Shou -Moshi Bakunyuu Akujo CA "Kurumi Maki" ga Hentai Buotoko Shuudan ni Yuukai Saretara-
original_name: 欲望回帰第405章-もし爆乳悪女CA『胡桃真希』が変態ブ男集団に誘拐されたら-
source: Kurumi Maki is a flight attendant whos "evil deeds" gets her into some serious trouble. follow our protagonist as she is kidnapped and gang raped by her "ugly" male victims.
translation: 真希胡美是一名空姐，她的“恶行”让她陷入了严重的麻烦。跟随我们的主角，她被“丑陋”的男性受害者绑架并轮奸。
